item.description:
Disk Manager 1.0.0 — first preview

A native macOS app to reclaim space on small SSDs.

  • Smart Cleanup: ~30 developer and app caches (Xcode, simulators, npm, pip/uv, Gradle, Homebrew, CocoaPods, Flutter, Go, Cargo…), labelled safe or caution.
  • Docker: OrbStack, Docker Desktop and Colima. Shows where the engine's disk image lives, what's reclaimable, and prunes in one click.
  • Project Junk: finds node_modules, venvs, Pods, .dart_tool and build folders, and selects those untouched for 30+ days.
  • Space Explorer: clickable treemap with Trash, Delete and Move to… (e.g. an external drive).
  • Large Files: every file over 50 MB, sortable and filterable.
  • Menu bar: free space at a glance.

Preview build: not yet notarized by Apple. After moving the app to Applications and trying to open it once, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Apple silicon and Intel.
